sourceEnglishObjective: Lead a complete roofing day in Spanish
sourceEnglishSpeaking: Roleplay the day from morning brief through tear-off, installation checks, weather decision, and closeout.
candidateObjective: 日本語で屋根工事の一日を通して作業班を指揮する。
candidateFocus: ～前に orders the briefing and tie-off before work. ～てから sequences tear-off and installation; ～たら triggers the weather response and closeout.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 屋根に上がる前に必ずハーネスをアンカーに接続します。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: We always tie off the harness before going up on the roof.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 班長は施工の各工程を確認します。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The crew lead checks each step of the installation.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 天候が変わったら作業を止めて降りてください。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: Stop work and come down if the weather changes.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 作業班は未完了の区画を防水シートで覆います。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The crew covers the unfinished section with a tarp.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 工事を完了とする前に、一緒に屋根を見て回りましょう。
archivedForms.meaningEnglish: to walk through / to go over (a roof, a site)
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: Walk the roof with me before we call the job complete.

archivedSpeaking.opening: 始める前に計画を確認しましょう。まず撤去、次に施工です。天候が変わったら作業を止め、残った項目は残工事リストに記録してください。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Roleplay the day from morning brief through tear-off, installation checks, weather decision, and closeout.

curriculumAdaptationNote: The current source objective explicitly says lead a complete roofing day in Spanish, while this exact Japanese-to-English adaptation proposes Japanese. Preserve the source's capstone sequence and flag that curriculum-language change for approval. Morning briefing and tie-off precede tear-off; a ready deck leads to underlayment/flashing checks; a storm warning arrives, the foreman gives a conditional stop/descent command, the crew covers an unfinished section, and final roof walk plus punch list close the day. The source does not identify an approved anchor, weather threshold, temporary-tarp procedure or product system. Hold fall-protection, storm response, roof-walk and installation commands for qualified safety/product review; do not silently register the archived Japanese as scored text. Current curriculum has no authored verb-example list; archived forms are conditional evidence. No selected learner/audio text or progress identity is created.

cards.reviewNote: Spanish Instalación is a noun while the English card says install and archived 施工する is a verb. Settle the part-of-speech and practice target rather than silently grading a different form.
Closeout / cierre de obra is the job closeout process, while archived 完了確認 is a final check. Confirm whether outstanding items and documentation belong in this sense.
Generic flashing / tapajuntas has several roof-system forms. Confirm archived 水切り板金 for this lesson's installation scope and contextual dictionary entry.
Tarp / lona is a temporary covering, while archived 防水シート can denote installed waterproofing material. Confirm the emergency-covering sense before a scored weather instruction.
Punch list / lista de pendientes records work remaining for closeout. Confirm 残工事リスト and whether it covers more than construction work in this scene.

cards.sourceSpanish: Repasemos el plan del techo de hoy antes de empezar.
cards.sourceEnglish: Let's review today's roof plan before we start.
cards.candidateJapanese: 始める前に今日の屋根工事の計画を確認しましょう。
cards.archivedJapanese: 始める前に今日の屋根工事の計画を確認しましょう。
cards.archivedEnglish: Let's review today's roof plan before we start.

cards.sourceSpanish: Anclen el arnés antes de subir al techo.
cards.sourceEnglish: Tie off before you go on the roof.
cards.archivedJapanese: 屋根に上がる前にハーネスをアンカーに接続してください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Tie off before you go on the roof.
cards.reviewNote: Source says tie off before going on the roof. Archived Japanese specifies connecting a harness to an anchor, which the source does not approve or identify; hold for qualified fall-protection review.

cards.sourceSpanish: Detengan el trabajo y bajen si cambia el tiempo.
cards.sourceEnglish: Stop work and come down if the weather changes.
cards.archivedJapanese: 天候が変わったら作業を止めて降りてください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Stop work and come down if the weather changes.
cards.reviewNote: Source orders stop and descent if weather changes, but the scene later has a storm warning. Confirm the site weather trigger, descent and communication sequence without inventing an unsafe universal rule.

cards.sourceSpanish: Recorran el techo conmigo antes de dar el trabajo por terminado.
cards.sourceEnglish: Walk the roof with me before we call the job complete.
cards.archivedJapanese: 工事を完了とする前に、一緒に屋根を見て回りましょう。
cards.archivedEnglish: Walk the roof with me before we call the job complete.
cards.reviewNote: The closing roof walk requires safe access after a storm warning and a partially covered section. Hold any scored command until qualified site/roof safety review.

cards.sourceSpanish: Primero el desmontaje, luego la instalación.
cards.archivedJapanese: まず既存屋根材を撤去し、その後に施工します。
cards.reviewNote: Tear-off then installation is the source's broad sequence. Keep it contextual; do not imply installation proceeds during unsafe weather or before deck/underlayment checks.

cards.sourceSpanish: La seguridad es lo primero hoy.
cards.candidateJapanese: 今日は安全を最優先にします。
cards.archivedJapanese: 今日は安全を最優先にします。

reader.sourceSpanish: Por la mañana, el capataz abre la reunión informativa: Repasemos el plan del techo de hoy antes de empezar.
reader.sourceEnglish: In the morning, the foreman opens the briefing: Let's review today's roof plan before we start.
reader.candidateJapanese: 朝、職長は打ち合わせを始め、「始める前に今日の屋根工事の計画を確認しましょう」と言います。
reader.archivedJapanese: 朝、職長は打ち合わせを始め、「始める前に今日の屋根工事の計画を確認しましょう」と言います。
reader.archivedEnglish: In the morning, the foreman opens the briefing: Let's review today's roof plan before we start.

reader.sourceSpanish: La seguridad es lo primero hoy.
reader.candidateJapanese: 今日は安全を最優先にします。
reader.archivedJapanese: 今日は安全を最優先にします。

reader.sourceSpanish: Anclen el arnés antes de subir al techo.
reader.sourceEnglish: Tie off before you go on the roof.
reader.archivedJapanese: 屋根に上がる前にハーネスをアンカーに接続してください。
reader.archivedEnglish: Tie off before you go on the roof.
reader.reviewNote: The tie-off command has no identified approved anchor or roof-access method; archived Japanese adds a specific harness-to-anchor action. Qualified fall-protection review needed.

reader.sourceSpanish: Primero el desmontaje, luego la instalación.
reader.archivedJapanese: まず既存屋根材を撤去し、その後に施工します。
reader.reviewNote: Tear-off then installation is a broad sequence and must remain conditional on the later deck and weather checks in this source scene.

reader.sourceSpanish: Cuando la cubierta está lista, la cuadrilla pone la sub-capa y el tapajuntas, y el jefe de cuadrilla revisa cada paso.
reader.sourceEnglish: When the deck is ready, the crew puts down the underlayment and the flashing, and the crew lead checks each step.
reader.archivedJapanese: 野地板の準備ができたら、作業班は下葺き材と水切り板金を取り付け、班長が各工程を確認します。
reader.archivedEnglish: When the deck is ready, the crew puts down the underlayment and the flashing, and the crew lead checks each step.
reader.reviewNote: Source deck is broader than archived 野地板 if the roof system differs; flashing/underlayment order and product-specific scope need qualified trade review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Por la tarde llega un aviso de tormenta, y el capataz ordena: Detengan el trabajo y bajen si cambia el tiempo.
reader.sourceEnglish: In the afternoon a storm warning arrives, and the foreman orders: Stop work and come down if the weather changes.
reader.archivedJapanese: 午後に嵐の警報が届き、職長は「天候が変わったら作業を止めて降りてください」と指示します。
reader.archivedEnglish: In the afternoon a storm warning arrives, and the foreman orders: Stop work and come down if the weather changes.
reader.reviewNote: A storm warning arrives before the quoted conditional weather-change command. Confirm the timing and whether work stops immediately under the site weather plan.

reader.sourceSpanish: La cuadrilla cubre con una lona la sección sin terminar.
reader.sourceEnglish: The crew covers the unfinished section with a tarp.
reader.archivedJapanese: 作業班は未完了の区画を防水シートで覆います。
reader.archivedEnglish: The crew covers the unfinished section with a tarp.
reader.reviewNote: The crew tarps an unfinished section after the storm warning. Confirm safe access, tie-off, wind and temporary-covering procedure; archived 防水シート may imply installed membrane.

reader.sourceSpanish: Al final del día, el capataz pide: Recorran el techo conmigo antes de dar el trabajo por terminado.
reader.sourceEnglish: At the end of the day, the foreman asks: Walk the roof with me before we call the job complete.
reader.archivedJapanese: 一日の終わりに職長は「工事を完了とする前に、一緒に屋根を見て回りましょう」と言います。
reader.archivedEnglish: At the end of the day, the foreman asks: Walk the roof with me before we call the job complete.
reader.reviewNote: The end-of-day roof walk follows a storm warning and temporary tarp. Confirm safe roof access and exact closeout authority before a scored command.

reader.sourceSpanish: Lo que falta queda en la lista de pendientes para el cierre de obra.
reader.sourceEnglish: Whatever is left stays on the punch list for the closeout.
reader.archivedJapanese: 残った項目は完了確認のため残工事リストに記録します。
reader.archivedEnglish: Whatever is left stays on the punch list for the closeout.
reader.reviewNote: Punch-list and closeout senses must preserve unresolved work rather than imply final acceptance. Confirm Japanese terms and documentation context.
